summary: Updated implementation plan incorporating user comments: (1) Hybrid GWP across all years without fixed year boundaries; (2) Dual CAP methodology: Algerian Decree 06-138 concentration-to-mass compliance combined with API Compendium 2021 emission factors; (3) Equity share percentage input box dynamically displayed when 'Equity Share' boundary is chosen in the Region/Facility form; (4) Granular production fields integrated directly into the existing Production Data tab; (5) Routine, Non-Routine, and Safety flaring added as first-class process types in the emissions calculator, with KPI cards displaying each volume breakdown and the grand total.
